Yes, you're still within the window. Orders can be changed or cancelled free within **2 hours** of ordering, from "My Orders". Since you ordered about 20 minutes ago, you have roughly 1 hour 40 minutes left.

- **Adding the pot:** Go to "My Orders" and open the order to make the change. My policy information says orders can be "changed" in that window, but it doesn't spell out whether adding a new item is supported. If you don't see an option to add the pot, tell me and I can escalate it.
- **After the 2 hours:** The order moves to the packing queue and can't be changed online. Support can try to intercept it before it ships, but that isn't guaranteed.
- **Promo codes:** A promo code can't be added after ordering, so a code can't be applied to the pot if you add it.
- **Plant pots:** Your ZZ plant will arrive in a plastic nursery pot with drainage holes. Decorative pots are sold separately unless the listing says "potted".
